prompt: Draft responses and objections to the attached first set of requests for production, plus an internal discovery issues memo for the supervising partner. Output: `rfp-responses.docx` and `discovery-issues-memo.docx`.
coverage: All45 criteria read; all7 files extracted and relevant document paragraphs/spreadsheet entries inspected. No actual litigation hold or full inadvertently produced Ng email supplied beyond log/summary descriptions; those limitations retained. No solver output accessed.

findings.description: Request24 seeks existing documents supporting affirmative defenses. Such documents are ordinarily discoverable and even within initial disclosure scope; it is not categorically an improper contention interrogatory. Specific overbreadth,prematurity,or opinion-work-product concerns may exist, but rubric mandates generic objection.
findings.repair: Credit production of nonprivileged supporting documents with particular supported objections; remove categorical improper-contention requirement.

findings.description: Section7.2 covers any nonpublic information disclosed in connection with agreement, including but not limited to enumerated categories. Absence of express BOM/manufacturing examples does not create the required coverage gap. Court protective order remains useful for other reasons.
findings.repair: Accept broad catch-all protection and recommend protective order for litigation disclosure without inventing exclusion.

findings.description: Potentially privileged email and vague entries merit prompt assessment, but label Privilege applies or outside-counsel reference alone does not establish privilege. Strengthening descriptions must follow actual content review. Actual hold memo not supplied, so mandatory opinion-work-product characterization rests on summary/log rather than inspection.
findings.evidence: collection-summary.docx p131,p144,p147 says potentially privileged and assess clawback; privilege-log.xlsx entries1-7,10.
findings.repair: Require content/purpose inquiry and truthful log supplementation; allow conditional claim pending review.

findings.description: Rule-compliant withholding statements should track actual objections; mandatory ten objections/statements can penalize a reasoned response set making fewer objections. Urgent preservation/clawback concern is reasonable, but exact two-issue urgency floor is not requested.
findings.evidence: task instructions; C036/C039; source reports require prompt attention.
findings.repair: Score accurate response content per applicable request and practical priority rather than numerical objection quota.

source_cross_checks: C-001-C-010/C-017-C-018/C-023-C-024/C-026-C-028/C-034-C-035/C-037-C-038/C-040/C-045: requests1-25,agreement dates,case caption and objection playbook cross-checked. Temporal narrowing/trade-secret/privacy objections are plausible strategy, not declared universally mandatory law.

C-011-C-016/C-032-C-033/C-042-C-044: seven earlyNg/Chen entries and fourTrent/Marsh common-interest entries verified; adverse-interest inquiry sensible; written agreement alone neither necessary nor sufficient.

C-019-C-022/C-029-C-031: collection-summary p19-p33,p98-p99,p140-p147 supports hold gap,90day Slack deletion,primary users and recovery attempt. Fact versus privileged preservation content distinction appropriate. Kessler-Foss email inspected for Northpoint relevance.
